messages.subject: boxplot legend
parts:
Dear ggplot2 users,

I am just starting and enjoying (a lot!) ggplot2.

I would have a very dummy question.

How do you change the legend of a boxplot (title and key labels)?

I have been able to change the legend of other plots but I could not
find the way for a boxplot.

For instance, I would try to change the legend of this plot:
p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(factor(cyl), mpg))
p + geom_boxplot(aes(fill = factor(am)))

Which kind of scale_ should I use?

In addition, it seems it is not possible to use expression() for the key
labels of a legend Am I wrong?

Thanks very much in advance for any tip,

Best regards,

Jerome

messages.subject: Re: boxplot legend
parts:
On Fri, Oct 16, 2009 at 03:55:29PM +0200, Jérôme Sueur wrote:
>
> How do you change the legend of a boxplot (title and key labels)?
>
> I have been able to change the legend of other plots but I could not
> find the way for a boxplot.
>
> For instance, I would try to change the legend of this plot:
> p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(factor(cyl), mpg))
> p + geom_boxplot(aes(fill = factor(am)))
>
> Which kind of scale_ should I use?

since you use discrete fill colour:

+ scale_fill_discrete("title",labels=c("zero","one"))

to change the legend title and labels.

> In addition, it seems it is not possible to use expression() for the key
> labels of a legend Am I wrong?
